name: Our Last Christmas
source:
Our Last Christmas is a short excerpt from my life. It was a sad but beautiful time. We lived our normal lives but with the knowledge that things were going to end.

This is a story of a queer romance with a definite end in sight, of two people who still love each other very much, but can't be together. And the normalcy that's still possible under those circumstances.

[From [url=https://easypeazygames.itch.io/our-last-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]

An entry for the Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022.
